hero.sub: Two cousins, one crew, and a truck you'll recognize on your street. We mow St. Augustine the way it likes it, keep your beds clean and set your sprinkler clock to your SAWS watering day.

water.title: We mow to your watering day
water.body: SAWS sets your watering day by the last digit of your address. We schedule your mow the day before, so the grass is cut dry and watered right after. Tell us your address and we'll look it up.

owner.story: Our uncle mowed lawns on the West Side for thirty years. We started Los Primos in 2016 with his old trailer and a Honda mower. Now there are six of us. One of us is at every job, and we both answer the phone.

faq.q: How much is lawn mowing in San Antonio?
faq.a: From $45 a visit for a quarter-acre lot. We measure on the free estimate and text you the price before we start.

faq.q: How short should St. Augustine be cut?
faq.a: About 3 to 4 inches. Cutting it short in summer burns it and invites chinch bugs, so we keep it tall.

faq.q: Do you work around SAWS watering rules?
faq.a: Yes. We schedule your mow the day before your watering day and set your sprinkler clock if it's wrong.
